description: Computed descriptive stories for any country in the frame (D192): shape_mirror (nearest capability profiles across the frame), peer_contrast (farthest shape among the 10 nearest income peers) and peer_standing (each dimension against the income-peer median, keeping thin-evidence dimensions out of headlines). Every score carries its confidence, band, indicator count, coverage flag and known limits.
